diagnosis.rule: MRI studies naming an explicit neurodevelopmental or psychiatric diagnosis

diagnosis_or_neuroscience.rule: the same, plus MRI studies using cognitive-neuroscience methods (resting-state and task fMRI, connectomics, brain age) or reporting cognitive or behavioral outcomes

impact.measure: FWCI where OpenAlex has computed it, else iCite RCR; 1.0 = the average paper of the same field and year
